name: Kayama Kaiji
source:
While stuck in the past, Kayama continues to drive his taxi through Shibuya. He's not driving due to work, but doing so to achieve a certain purpose. Unrelated to his turmoil, various people keep trying to enter his cab.

[Translated from [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/260728t]profile[/url]]
